rules.title: The crown resolved outside the Verdict (one chain)
rules.fix: Read verdict.current(session, pooled_fp) and its typed fields. The Verdict is the one place the crown is decided (plan: one chain, S4).

rules.title: A reader asks a single judge for the crown instead of the Verdict
rules.fix: Read the crown and its evidence from verdict.current() (or GET /api/verdict). A judge's own crown is evidence shown beside the Verdict, never a crown a reader acts on.

rules.title: A profile promoted to the firewall by something other than Auto-apply
rules.fix: Engines measure and the ring decides; Auto-apply (crown_follower) is the one writer that leaves a profile on the firewall. Make the engine's winner a ring candidate instead (plan: one chain, S12).

rules.title: A view reads a crown field other than the Verdict
rules.fix: Read the crown from GET /api/verdict, so every screen names the same profile Auto-apply follows (plan: one chain, S8 to S10).

rules.title: A data class, Pydantic model or TypedDict declared outside the model files
rules.fix: Add the shape to the model file that owns its layer (ORM: app/models.py, API: app/schemas.py, engine: tco_engine/models.py) or reuse one there.

rules.title: A function that returns a bare dict or Any instead of a typed shape
rules.fix: Return a typed model (a Pydantic response model or an engine dataclass). If it goes to the frontend, it is part of the API contract and needs a schema in app/schemas.py.

rules.title: type: ignore or cast()
rules.fix: Fix the type instead of silencing it.

rules.title: A JSON/Text column holding structured data
rules.fix: Give the structure its own table, or a Pydantic model that every read parses through.

rules.title: A nullable column whose null has no written meaning
rules.fix: Write what None means in a comment just above the column, once, so no reader decides it for itself (the untagged-licence-line bug).

rules.title: Schema changed from application code instead of a migration
.get() with a fallback on a dict that should have a known shape
rules.fix: Read a typed field. If the key can be missing, model that as an explicit state in the type.

rules.title: A frontend file in plain JavaScript (no type checks against the API)
rules.fix: Write new frontend files as .ts/.tsx using types generated from the backend's OpenAPI schema. Converting an existing .jsx file lowers this count.
